history.sg_progress: The Administration will continue to request implementing partners to submit recruitment results in a timely manner. The Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs is also maintaining performance assessment results for consultants and/or experts recruited at the completion of their assignment. However, it should be noted that implementing this recommendation in full may not be feasible because not only of the sensitive and confidential nature of individual performance reports, but also doing so may not be consistent with existing United Nations human resources regulations and rules. In addition, the role of the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs is to provide names and profiles of pre-screened roster candidates to UNDP, to help to facilitate the expedited filling of relevant vacant positions at UNDP. The Department does not involve itself in the selection processes or in the administration of selected candidates. Accordingly, the Department does not have the right to request personnel information such as performance evaluation records of UNDP staff.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that the implementing partners of electoral projects submit, in a timely manner, the recruitment results of candidates and the performance assessment results of the consultants and/or experts on the electoral roster after the completion of the assignment.
history.administration_response: In compliance with this recommendation, Electoral Assistance Division has taken steps to further strengthen its efforts to maintain recruitment and performance assessment results for the consultants and experts recruited by the Division. In addition, given that the majority of the electoral experts deployed in the field continued to be recruited by field offices, including UNDP country offices, which are implementing most of the United Nations electoral assistance projects in the field, the Division is in consultation with these United Nations partners to find out how best this recommendation can be implemented to the extent possible, including through an instruction from UNDP to all electoral projects in the field, asking them to ensure that recruitment results (and, to the extent possible, performance evaluations) are shared with the Division.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs will continue to request implementing partners to submit recruitment results in a timely manner, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that the implementing partners of electoral projects submit, in a timely manner, the recruitment results of candidates and the performance assessment results of the consultants and/or experts on the electoral roster after completion of the assignment.
history.administration_response: The Electoral Assistance Division now receive outcomes of recruitment exercises from UNDP and other entities that use the United Nations single electoral roster. The Electoral Assistance Division will continue to follow up with subsequent roster recruitments to receive the results. On performance evaluations, the Electoral Assistance Division continues to seek guidance from the Human Resources Services Division of the Department of Operational Support on the matter and will follow whatever guidance is provided. The Electoral Assistance Division also followed up with UNDP, which informed the Division that the only formal evaluation of UNDP staff is an annual performance review, the results of which are confidential.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Electoral Assistance Division continues to receive outcomes of recruitment exercises from UNDP and other entities and will continue to follow up with subsequent roster recruitments, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
